verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs describe fine-grained reactive state updates via Signals. A community production user cites AOT compilation, and another reports strong rendering performance. Together these suggest a compiler-optimized, fine-grained update model, but nothing in the pack states that DOM updates skip a virtual-DOM diffing step. missing for 10: explicit documentation that rendering avoids virtual DOM diffing, first-party docs on how the compiler optimizes DOM updates, how Signals map to targeted DOM updates, independent benchmarks of the current renderer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler-optimized rendering system that updates the DOM without a virtual DOM diffing step

citations.quote: Reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals
optimized code renders about 2x faster than other frameworks
